claude_proposed_widenings.name: OngoingOperation.apply_condition
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Invisibility's core mechanic is granting the Invisible condition to the touched creature. The current OngoingOperation union only contains roll_modifier and damage_on_hit — neither can represent condition application. A new apply_condition operation variant is required.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: A creature you touch has the Invisible condition until the spell ends.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: Condition.invisible
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The Condition type currently only contains 'prone'. Invisibility requires 'invisible' as a valid Condition value for the apply_condition operation.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: A creature you touch has the Invisible condition until the spell ends.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: SelfBreakTrigger (new surface type for early concentration/duration termination)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Invisibility ends early when the subject makes an attack roll, deals damage, or casts a spell. This is a self_break lifecycle atom (exists in v4), but there is no surface shape to express it. The Duration type has no field for early termination conditions, and no SelfBreakTrigger type exists. A new closed grammar of subject-action triggers is needed (subject_makes_attack_roll, subject_deals_damage, subject_casts_spell) attached to the duration or spell mechanics header.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: The spell ends early immediately after the target makes an attack roll, deals damage, or casts a spell.
